checkpointPayload.description: Add local custom team CRUD separate from synced game teams; prioritize custom teams in raid/farm selectors; lowest-five selection must consider hero availability.
checkpointPayload.title: Manage custom raid and farm teams and select available lowest-power heroes

newValue.text: Custom teams can be created, edited and deleted independently of game synced teams.
Raid and farm dropdowns show custom teams first.
Lowest-power lineup selects only available heroes and refreshes at selection/dispatch.

taskChanges.newValue: 1. Inspect team storage, dropdowns, and hero availability. 2. Add persistent account-local custom team CRUD and custom-first raid/farm options. 3. Resolve lowest-five from currently available heroes on selection and dispatch. 4. Add regression tests and run checks/build.
